# telnyx_inexplicit_number_order (Data Source)

An order for phone numbers by criteria, such as a quantity in an area, instead of specific numbers. Orders cannot be cancelled through the API.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the inexplicit number order

### Read-Only

- `billing_group_id` (String) Billing group id to apply to phone numbers that are purchased
- `connection_id` (String) Connection id to apply to phone numbers that are purchased
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created
- `customer_reference` (String) Reference label for the customer
- `messaging_profile_id` (String) Messaging profile id to apply to phone numbers that are purchased
- `ordering_groups` (Attributes List) Group(s) of numbers to order. You can have multiple ordering_groups objects added to a single request. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ordering_groups))
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was updated

<a id="nestedatt--ordering_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ordering_groups`

Read-Only:

- `administrative_area` (String) Filter for phone numbers in a given state / province
- `count_allocated` (Number) Quantity of phone numbers allocated
- `count_requested` (String) Quantity of phone numbers requested
- `country_iso` (String) Country where you would like to purchase phone numbers One of `CA`, `US`.
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the ordering group was created
- `error_reason` (String) Error reason if applicable
- `exclude_held_numbers` (Boolean) Filter to exclude phone numbers that are currently on hold/reserved for your account.
- `features` (List of String) Filter for phone numbers that have the features to satisfy your use case (e.g., ["voice"]) The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `locality` (String) Filter for phone numbers in a given city / region / rate center The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `national_destination_code` (String) Filter by area code
- `orders` (Attributes List) Array of orders created to fulfill the inexplicit order (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ordering_groups--orders))
- `phone_number` (Attributes) Phone number search criteria The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ordering_groups--phone_number))
- `phone_number_contains` (String) Filter for phone numbers that contain the digits specified
- `phone_number_ends_with` (String) Filter by the ending digits of the phone number
- `phone_number_starts_with` (String) Filter by the starting digits of the phone number
- `phone_number_type` (String) Number type
- `quickship` (Boolean) Filter to exclude phone numbers that need additional time after to purchase to activate. Only applicable for +1 toll_free numbers.
- `status` (String) Status of the ordering group
- `strategy` (String) Ordering strategy used One of `always`, `never`.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the ordering group was updated

<a id="nestedatt--ordering_groups--orders"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ordering_groups.orders`

Read-Only:

- `number_order_id` (String) ID of the main number order
- `sub_number_order_ids` (List of String) Array of sub number order IDs


<a id="nestedatt--ordering_groups--phone_number"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ordering_groups.phone_number`

Read-Only:

- `contains` (String) Filter for phone numbers that contain the digits specified The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `ends_with` (String) Filter by the ending digits of the phone number The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `starts_with` (String) Filter by the starting digits of the phone number The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
